title: سيغا (SEGA) عن النسخة الكاملة من SHOGUN 2: «التجربة الحالية ليست بالمستوى المطلوب»

claims.text: SEGA and CA: fallen short of expectations and standards; current experience not where it needs to be
Working with platform holders to temporarily remove from sale and reinstate the original
Existing owners keep access and can play
No refund terms; statement does not mention AI
Players claim AI upscaling of art
